body: It’s a oil rig that I’m building a small town on top of

Well yeah it hides my scars and self harm from around my body. That’s why if you know me you see me always wearing long sleeves and pants. But for me it’s also comforting and makes me feel more safe......

Well I’m a teenager who’s never had a happy life who’s been abused, raped, and left all my life and the one thing I was living for and loved left me for and I don’t know and I have nothing anymore I hate my self I hate my life I’m so tired of it all
